trafficFirst.rule: The largest short-term constraint is qualified traffic, not product count.
actions: Use free PWA/web tools as search and Microsoft Store acquisition surfaces.
Cap near-duplicate free tools and paid SKUs.
Once a paid URL is verified, add one context-matched CTA to the relevant free tool.
If a category shows sales, concentrate pages and products around that buyer problem instead of broadening randomly.
Prefer distribution expansion or license ladders over increasing SKU count once a category has enough products.
